notes:
### New
- **Two-way sync.** Krate now remembers what Rekordbox and Engine DJ held
  after your last sync, and the next sync applies what you changed in
  either app since then: track info, ratings, cues and beatgrids go from
  Rekordbox to Engine DJ and back (loops one way for now). When the same
  track changed in both, the newest change wins; Settings → Sync can ask
  you instead.
- **Check USB stick** now also reads sticks that only have Rekordbox's
  database for older players (CDJ-2000NXS2, XDJ-XZ, CDJ-3000 before
  firmware 3.30), and warns when a stick's two Rekordbox databases list
  different playlists, so newer and older players would show different
  things.
- **Tidy → Smart fixes:** "Split artist out of the title" also removes the
  artist from titles that repeat it ("Cristina Lazic - Jumpin'" with
  artist Cristina Lazic → "Jumpin'"). New fix **Remove the label from
  titles**: "Jumpin' (Original Mix) - Bamboleo" → "Jumpin' (Original
  Mix)" when the end is the track's label.

### Fixes
- Syncing into a brand-new Engine DJ library (one Engine has just
  created, with no tracks yet) no longer stops with "FOREIGN KEY
  constraint failed".
- Hot cue colours saved to Rekordbox now arrive as the right colour, also
  on USB sticks you export. Krate's hot cue colours are now exactly
  Rekordbox's, and other colours get the nearest Rekordbox colour instead
  of green. Krate also shows all of Rekordbox's cue colours.
